front.intro: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside of this East End bungalow, and a new driveway runs back along the side of the house. Inside are new wiring, new plumbing and three-phase power, with a new kitchen and two new baths. Wood-look floors run from the front door through the Living Room, the Dining Area and the Kitchen. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away.

cap.name: Front of the Home
cap.text: A board and batten gable sits over the covered stoop at the front of the bungalow. Hardi Plank siding covers the exterior. A short flight of steps leads up to the stoop.

left.kicker: Inside · The front of the house
left.title: The front rooms, from several angles

rows.name: Living Room
rows.text: The front door opens into the Living Room. A clerestory window high on the wall adds daylight and keeps privacy. Wood-look flooring runs through every main room. A wide cased opening leads on through the Dining Area and into the Kitchen, over wood-look floors the whole way.

rows.name: Front Entry
rows.text: The front door opens straight into the Living Room, with the Dining Area and the Kitchen beyond it. Wood-look floors run from the door to the Kitchen with no thresholds between rooms.

rows.name: Breakfast Bar
rows.text: The peninsula doubles as the Breakfast Bar between the Kitchen and the Dining Area. The Dining Area sits right beside the bar.

rows.name: Kitchen
rows.text: The Kitchen is laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens to the Dining Area and the Living Room. The range, the sink and the dishwasher sit a step apart along the L. A pantry measuring 4' x 3' is just around the corner.

rows.name: Range Wall
rows.text: Navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers frame a stainless range under a chimney hood. A full-height marble-look backsplash runs behind the counters. The sink sits under a window.

rows.name: Breakfast Nook
rows.text: The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door out to the rear deck and the backyard. The pantry is a few steps away.

right.title: A vaulted Primary at the back

rows.name: Primary Bedroom
rows.text: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, in the rear corner of the house, away from the street and the front rooms. A double-door closet and the doorway to the Primary Bath share one wall. The Primary Bedroom sits across the house from Bedroom 2.

rows.name: Primary Bath
rows.text: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity with drawers. A wide LED mirror runs nearly the full width above the sinks. The glass shower has a rain showerhead and a handheld, and marble-look tile from floor to ceiling.

rows.name: Hall Bath
rows.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, a few steps from each. The tub has a full-height marble-look tile surround and a pebble tile niche.

rows.name: Primary Closet
rows.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves sit above the hanging rods on both sides.

rows.name: Bedroom 2
rows.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, across the home from the Primary. It shares the hall bath with Bedroom 3. It's at the front corner of the home, apart from the Primary at the back. The larger of the two secondary bedrooms, in a front corner, with a window on each outside wall.

rows.name: Bedroom 3
rows.text: The hall bath is a few steps away. A large window brings in natural light, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary. It sits next to the Primary.

back.title: Covered space beyond the house

photos.name: Covered Garage
photos.text: The covered garage sits at the back of the lot, beside an open concrete patio that measures 8' x 25'. A new driveway runs back along the side of the house to the garage. The whole yard is fully fenced.

photos.name: Backyard Deck
photos.text: Steps lead from the Breakfast Nook's rear door down to the deck. The deck looks out over the backyard. The rear of the house shows the same Hardi Plank siding as the front.
